Struggling with pain, posture issues, or symptoms that haven’t improved?
Watch real, unedited chiropractic visits focused on precise neck adjustments and full-body balance.
Patients travel from around the world to experience this approach.

Dr. Ace Thayer is a chiropractor in Costa Mesa, California with 30+ years of experience. This channel shows how targeted chiropractic care can improve mobility, reduce discomfort, and support overall function.

Using a top-down, brain-body approach—known as the Thayer Method—Dr. Thayer shares real patient cases to educate and inform those exploring chiropractic care.

📍 Costa Mesa, CA
🎥 New videos weekly
👉 Subscribe for adjustments, patient cases & movement education
